title: Quasi-isomorphism from exhaustive filtered graded pieces
statement: Use the cochain-complex and quasi-isomorphism conventions of [lem-coef-dgcat-model-structure]. Let $f:P\to Q$ be a chain map of cochain complexes of abelian groups, and let $0=P_0\subset P_1\subset\cdots$ and $0=Q_0\subset Q_1\subset\cdots$ be increasing sequences of subcomplexes with $f(P_i)\subseteq Q_i$ for every $i$, each inclusion split on the underlying graded abelian groups, and with $P=\bigcup_iP_i$ and $Q=\bigcup_iQ_i$. If every induced map on successive quotient complexes $P_{i+1}/P_i\to Q_{i+1}/Q_i$ is a quasi-isomorphism, then $f$ is a quasi-isomorphism. Consequently, for a map of dg modules over a small dg category with such filtrations by dg submodules at every object, whose quotient maps are objectwise quasi-isomorphisms, the map is an objectwise quasi-isomorphism.
